First, we convert all measurements to compatible units. Let's convert the length from meters to millimeters and the width from millimeters to centimeters, then calculate the area in square centimeters.

The length of the strip Aisha can paint is \(25\) meters. Converting this into millimeters (since \(1\) meter = \(1000\) millimeters):
\[
25 \text{ meters} = 25 \times 1000 \text{ millimeters} = 25000 \text{ millimeters}
\]

The width of the paintbrush is \(6.5\) millimeters. Converting this unit to centimeters (since \(10\) millimeters = \(1\) centimeter):
\[
6.5 \text{ millimeters} = 0.65 \text{ centimeters}
\]

Now, calculate the area Aisha can cover. The area \(A\) of a rectangle is given by the formula:

\[
A = \text{length} \times \text{width}
\]

Substituting the converted values into the formula gives:
\[
A = 25000 \text{ mm} \times 0.65 \text{ cm} = 16250 \text{ square centimeters}
\]

This result corresponds to answer choice \(\textbf{(B)}\) 16,250. Therefore, the correct answer replicated five times is:
\[
\textbf{BBBBB}
\]
